gloss: electrical work; electrical construction or installation

definitions.gloss: electrical work — construction, installation, or repair of electrical wiring and equipment
definitions.explanation: The trade and work of installing, maintaining, or repairing electrical systems in buildings, including wiring, outlets, lighting, and major appliances. In Japan, most {電気工事|でんきこうじ} must be performed by a licensed {電気工事士|でんきこうじし} ('licensed electrician').

examples.japanese: あした⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{電気工事|でんきこうじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Tomorrow the power will be off due to electrical work.

examples.japanese: {電気工事|でんきこうじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can't do electrical work without a license.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦リフォーム→リフォーム：08821_rifoomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ついで⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配線|はいせん}→配線：07862_haisen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{電気工事|でんきこうじ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いする→お願いする：05654_onegaisuru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: Since we bought an old house, we decided to have wiring work done as part of the renovation.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧ ('electricity') and ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ ('construction work'). A general term for any construction or installation task involving electrical systems.

USAGE:
- Used both for major projects (wiring a new building) and small jobs (installing a new outlet or light fixture).
- Because Japanese law restricts much electrical work to holders of the {電気工事士|でんきこうじし} license, signage and paperwork in this field frequently mention the word. Homeowners hire a {電気工事屋|でんきこうじや} ('electrical contractor') for such work.
- Planned power outages due to building maintenance are commonly announced as {電気工事|でんきこうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧ 'There will be a power outage due to electrical work'.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電気工事|でんきこうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out electrical work
- {電気工事|でんきこうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}する→依頼する：21376_irai⟧: to request electrical work
- {電気工事|でんきこうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧: power outage due to electrical work
- {電気工事|でんきこうじ}{会社|がいしゃ}: electrical contractor company

RELATED WORDS:
- {電気工事士|でんきこうじし}: licensed electrician — the national qualification required to perform most electrical work.
- ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧: construction work — general term.
- ⟦{配線|はいせん}→配線：07862_haisen⟧: wiring — the specific task of routing electrical cables.
- ⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧: power outage — common consequence of {電気工事|でんきこうじ}.
